inputs.question: Are the overhead electric lines labeled with voltage information (such as 12.47kV, 34.5kV, 69kV, 138kV, etc.) on the site plans? This will determine if they are distribution (under 60kV) or transmission (60kV and above) lines.
inputs.regionHint: utility lines showing overhead electric with possible voltage labels
